popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias' Spartan and Theran antiquities — Theras as guardian of the Eurysthenid twins who leads Minyan settlers to Calliste and gives the island his name.

popCulture.title: Histories
popCulture.creator: Herodotus
popCulture.description: Herodotus recounts the Lacedaemonian colony on Calliste — Theras the Theban-Spartan founder whose name the island of Thera still carries.
